item.title: Tao Warns of AI Outsourcing Risk, Advocates Math 2.0 Era
item.description:
Fields Medalist Terence Tao warns that outsourcing problem-solving to AI risks eroding human understanding of underlying logic. He highlights dangers in real-world domains like power grids and chip design where AI may exploit model loopholes, advocating for a 'Math 2.0' paradigm that prioritizes human verification and judgment over mere answer generation.

原文标题：陶哲轩警告 AI 替代思考风险 呼吁转向 Math 2.0

Why it matters：顶级数学家对 AI 认知外包风险的权威警示，涉及关键基础设施安全与科研范式变革，具有极高的行业反思价值。

item.title: Living Brain Decouples Memory into Independent Layer for Cross-Model Sharing
item.description:
Living Brain decouples AI memory from reasoning models to create an independent persistent storage layer. It enables shared context across ChatGPT, Claude, and custom agents via MCP or APIs, reducing task costs by up to 95% and token usage by 22.6x through precise retrieval of relevant memories instead of full history.

原文标题：Living Brain 将记忆解耦为独立层，支持跨模型共享与低成本检索

Why it matters：解决了多模型间记忆孤岛问题，并提供了显著的成本优化数据，对构建长期运行 Agent 的开发者具有较高参考价值。

item.title: Jaron Lanier Warns AI Repeats Social Media Mistakes
item.description:
Tech thinker Jaron Lanier argues in a podcast that current AI development is repeating the negative patterns of social media. He warns that without respect for data ownership and human agency, AI may exacerbate polarization and information manipulation. The discussion focuses on tech ethics and societal impact rather than technical breakthroughs.

原文标题：Jaron Lanier 警示 AI 重蹈社交媒体覆辙

Why it matters：知名学者对 AI 社会影响的批判性思考，适合关注科技伦理的读者。

item.title: Xiaomi Deploys WorldCast Framework on Redmi K100 for Photo-to-3D Video Generation
item.description:
Xiaomi has deployed the WorldCast visual generation framework on the Redmi K100 smartphone. The system converts static photos into 3D scenes by interpreting depth structures and simulates real camera trajectories to generate dynamic videos with consistent subject appearance. This marks a transition from research paper to on-device product implementation in controllable visual generation.

原文标题：小米 WorldCast 框架上线 REDMI K100，实现照片转 3D 运镜视频

item.title: Nebius Shares Drop as Texas Votes to Pause Data Center Permits
item.description:
Nebius Group shares fell up to 5% following a Texas election that empowered Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa to pause new data center permits. Although Nebius has no disclosed facilities in Texas, investors feared the halt would impact the state's 27% share of planned U.S. capacity, triggering a broader sell-off in GPU cloud stocks like CoreWeave.

原文标题：德州暂停数据中心审批致 Nebius 股价下跌

item.title: ByteDance Pauses Coze Enterprise Sales for Product Integration
item.description:
ByteDance's AI development platform Coze has paused new sales of its enterprise edition to facilitate product integration and upgrades. Existing customers retain service during their contract terms, with legacy plans retiring by end-2026 and new enterprise plans by end-2027. This move reflects ByteDance's strategy to consolidate tools like TRAE and Coze into the Doubao ecosystem, restructuring its Agent productivity portfolio.

Why it matters：虽为常规商业调整，但揭示了字节跳动在 Agent 时代对核心生产力工具链的战略重组与品牌统一动向。

item.title: Blogger Argues Visible AI Disaster Beats Silent Integration Despite Hinton Warnings
item.description:
Responding to Geoffrey Hinton's warnings about potential AI-induced grid or financial failures, the author argues that a visible disaster is preferable to silent, total societal integration. The piece critiques mainstream regulatory narratives, suggesting that if AI evolves without obvious harm, humanity faces deeper structural risks regarding energy waste and intellectual erosion.

item.description:

The update integrates complex physical properties (gravity, fluidity, etc.) into spatial modeling to generate interactive, real-time renderable 4D Gaussian assets, claiming inference costs are reduced to 30% of equivalent GPU solutions.

item.description:
NIO CEO William Li stated at the World Internet Conference that smart electric vehicles are currently the most shipped embodied agents and the largest AI application industry. Citing MIIT data showing over 60 million cars with assisted driving features, he revealed NIO's world model-based system is deployed on 950,000 vehicles. This perspective aims to redefine autonomous driving within the context of embodied intelligence.

item.title: Chinese Firms Order 6M Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 Cards Amid Supply Crunch
item.description:
Major Chinese tech firms including Alibaba, Tencent, and ByteDance have ordered approximately 6 million Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 GPUs worth $70 billion, yet Nvidia can supply only about 1% within the next four months. Demand is driven by the card's compliance with US export limits and its 84GB GDDR7 memory, which enables single-card inference for 70B-parameter models. However, global production is capped at an estimated 3 million units in 2027 as TSMC capacity shifts to Rubin chips, creating a severe supply-demand gap.

原文标题：中国云厂商订购 600 万张 RTX Pro 5500 显卡 供需缺口巨大

Why it matters：揭示了地缘政治背景下高端 AI 算力硬件的极端供需失衡及具体技术规格对采购决策的影响。

item.description:
Alphabet's earnings reveal that despite search queries hitting a five-year high, revenue growth slowed to 12% YoY due to rising AI infrastructure costs and decelerating paid clicks. Investors are questioning Google's ability to monetize AI effectively compared to its legacy search engine, triggering a ~14% drop in share price.

item.title: Altman Clarifies Memory Remarks: Claims Out-of-Context, Urges Capacity Expansion
item.description:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed backlash over his comments suggesting personal PC memory is inefficiently allocated, clarifying that he advocates for global DRAM capacity expansion to support AI infrastructure rather than restricting user ownership. Despite the clarification, the AI-driven memory shortage—dubbed the 'RAMpocalypse'—has already triggered price hikes in consumer hardware, fueling ongoing debates about resource allocation fairness.

item.title: Oracle Cancels $7B Tencent AI Chip Lease After US Objections
item.description:
Oracle has cancelled a $7 billion, five-year lease with Tencent after US objections, stripping access to up to 100K advanced AI chips via Southeast Asian data centers. This move, alongside Nvidia's new resale restrictions, cuts off a critical overseas compute channel for Chinese labs and leaves Tencent facing a training capacity gap just as its Hunyuan models compete with Alibaba's Qwen.

item.title: AI Ranked Last in Voter Priorities for 2026 U.S. Midterms
item.description:
NBC News exit polls reveal that AI and data center expansion ranked last among voter priorities in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections. Despite a recent surge in public interest, only 56% of respondents deemed the issue decisive or important for their vote, significantly trailing government corruption (90%) and cost of living (89%).

item.title: Tsinghua Study Reveals Critical Failures in AI Agent Memory Deletion
item.description:
A new Tsinghua University paper reveals that AI agents with long-term memory fail to cleanly delete personal data upon user request. Testing across six memory systems showed an end-to-end success rate of less than 1.5%, with most deleted facts still extractable via simple prompts. The study urges developers to implement and verify actual deletion paths rather than relying on superficial confirmation messages.

原文标题：清华研究揭示 AI 智能体长期记忆删除机制严重失效

Why it matters：揭示了当前 AI 智能体在隐私合规与数据生命周期管理上的核心缺陷，对开发者具有极高的警示价值。

item.title: Hinton 警告：AI 或致重大事故，人类可能本不该开发它
item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Gemini 付费用户聊天数据仍用于训练且无法单独退出
item.description:
Google Gemini 个人版订阅用户的聊天历史默认用于模型训练，且无独立关闭选项。用户若不想被训练，必须完全关闭“保留活动”功能，但这会导致聊天记录在 72 小时后自动删除。此外，部分对话会被人工审核并保留长达三年，官方明确警告勿输入机密信息。

Why it matters：揭示了主流 AI 产品隐私政策的重大漏洞，直接影响企业和个人用户对敏感数据的处理决策。

item.title: 招商局发布 Lion-ER-35B-A3B 具身推理模型 主打能力牵引数据引擎
item.description:
招商局狮子山实验室发布开源具身推理视觉语言模型「驭物™ Lion-ER-35B-A3B」。该模型采用 MoE 架构（总参 35B，激活 3B），摒弃单纯堆砌数据路线，转而构建“能力牵引”的数据引擎，通过拆解 8 大领域与 39 项细粒度能力进行正向设计与闭环迭代。在十项主流具身基准上实现全指标上涨，多项核心能力超越更大参数模型，旨在提升机器人对三维空间、物体状态及任务进度的理解能力。

Why it matters：提供了具身智能领域区别于传统数据堆砌的新范式（能力牵引数据引擎），且模型已开源并具备实际评测结果，对机器人开发者有直接参考价值。
